metadata.experiment: RAMA Integration: RelGNN vs baseline on rel-f1 and rel-amazon
metadata.description: Tests RAMA against standard sum aggregation using RelGNN on rel-f1/driver-position and rel-amazon/item-ltv (regression/MAE). RAMA enriches mean pooling with gated per-dimension variance conditioned on spectral rank proxy and cardinality.

rel-f1/driver-position.note: RAMA was worse with HeteroSAGE on F1

rel-amazon/item-ltv.note: RAMA was dramatically better with HeteroSAGE on Amazon
